# has trademark

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasTrademark`](gmeow-hasTrademark.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasTrademark>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates an entity (a mark, product or organization) to a trademark right over it.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) -> [`gmeow:Trademark`](../classes/gmeow-Trademark.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasTrademark`](gmeow-hasTrademark.md) from [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) to [`gmeow:Trademark`](../classes/gmeow-Trademark.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md), [`gmeow:Trademark`](../classes/gmeow-Trademark.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to link an entity — a mark, product, or organization — to the [`gmeow:Trademark`](../classes/gmeow-Trademark.md) right held over it.

### Avoid when

- Avoid pointing it at the sign itself in place of the protected entity (the mark is bound on the relator via [`gmeow:trademarkMark`](gmeow-trademarkMark.md)) and avoid using it for copyright or licence links.

### How to use

- Assert one [`gmeow:hasTrademark`](gmeow-hasTrademark.md) per held right pointing at a [`gmeow:Trademark`](../classes/gmeow-Trademark.md) relator that carries the mark, holder, registration, and status.

### Examples

- ex:blackcat [`gmeow:hasTrademark`](gmeow-hasTrademark.md) ex:blackcatTM.
